button.name: action_submit_for_approval
button.invisible: not can_submit or not has_approval_definition or not assessment_complete

div.p: Based on the assessment responses, this person meets the disability threshold ( domain(s) with significant difficulty).

This assessment cannot be submitted for approval yet. An administrator must create an approval workflow in Approvals → Approval Definitions (Model = Disability Assessment), then select it under Settings → Disability Registry → Approval.

div.invisible: approval_state != 'draft' or not has_approval_definition or assessment_complete

div.strong: Complete the required tabs to submit
div.p: Answer the impairment question on the Impairment Classification tab and, where required, complete the WG/CFM Assessment questionnaire. The Submit button appears once all required tabs are complete.
Add one row per impairment type, each with its own cause and severity. The overall severity (shown on the registrant) is the most severe level across the rows.
Rate the difficulty for each domain. A person has a disability if any domain is "A lot of difficulty" or "Cannot do at all".

div.div: Difficulty seeing, even if wearing glasses?
Difficulty hearing, even if using a hearing aid?
Difficulty walking or climbing steps?
Difficulty remembering or concentrating?
Difficulty with self-care (washing, dressing)?
Difficulty communicating (understanding or being understood) in their usual language?

div.p: A child meets the disability threshold if any domain is answered "A lot of difficulty"/"Cannot do at all" (or, for controlling behaviour, "A lot more").

div.div: Does the child wear glasses?

Does the child have difficulty hearing sounds like people's voices or music?

With his/her equipment or assistance, does the child have difficulty walking?

div.p: A child meets the disability threshold if any domain is answered "A lot of difficulty"/"Cannot do at all" (or, for anxiety and depression, occurs "Daily").
